description: This file defines a WearableListenerService that listens for specific messages from a wearable device and responds by launching the MainActivity when a matching message is received.

classes.name: WearableMessageListenerService
classes.description: A service extending WearableListenerService that listens for wearable messages and starts an activity based on message content.

methods.name: onMessageReceived
methods.description: Handles incoming message events and triggers the start of MainActivity if the message path matches the predefined trigger.
